description: Moving code from an older three release (r1xx) to the installed one, or to a given release: the breaking changes per release that apply to THIS code (renames, removed APIs, changed behaviour, changed look), each with file:line, a TO DO list for the hand work with the replacement checked against the installed API, the places three_fix renames, and what will look different (colour management, physical lights, PBR and AO changes). `from` auto reads CDN URLs, package.json, @types/three, the lockfile and git history. Data from the three.js migration guide, a source link per change. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

files.description: only these files, relative to the project

from.description: release the code was written for, e.g. r150 (default auto)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

to.description: release to move to, e.g. r188 (default: the installed one)

webgpu.description: also the WebGPU readiness: blockers (GLSL materials, onBeforeCompile, EffectComposer, WebGL-only code), the steps, a score, and a TSL draft module per ShaderMaterial / onBeforeCompile

write.description: make the exact rewrites (the three_fix renames and the migration's own) as one undoable step; default false shows the plan and what it would rewrite

name: three_migrate
title: Plan a three.js release upgrade
